entities.summary: Frederick William III, Duke of Schleswig-Holstein-Sonderburg-Beck was a military leaders & commanders in Germany (1723-11-04 – 1757-05-06), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Determined military outcomes shaping geopolitical boundaries.
